facts.value: Church government by councils of representative presbyters (elders), between episcopacy and congregationalism.

citations.excerpt: In episcopacy the supreme authority is a diocesan bishop; in congregationalism it is the members of the congregation assembled in church meeting; in Presbyterianism it is a church council composed of representative presbyters.

facts.value: The Scottish, English and derived churches named Presbyterian.

citations.excerpt: the Scotch, English, and derived churches as Presbyterian.

facts.value_before_verify: The Scottish, English and derived churches of the Calvinist Reformation, governed by presbyteries.
